local sigma is faithful. No older frozen claim is modified.

broadcaster C:B->B1 tensor B2, with the output spaces identified with B, and
ANY faithful fixed sigma. No equal marginals, stationarity, KMS symmetry,
modular covariance, or state-label input is required of the raw map.

 e_Psi(rho)=T[rho,(id_R tensor Psi)rho].              (P)

The same Psi applies simultaneously to the entire class of states with
this exact local marginal, not only a chosen finite list. A bounded MI
budget is needed to state a uniform numerical family bound, not to choose
the map. All trace distances are HALF trace norms and logs are natural.

ALL full-domain local EB maps, and delta_SEP(rho) its half-trace distance

delta_SEP<=delta_EB<=e_Psi. When I=I(R:B)>0, (P) gives

division by zero is asserted. Faithful sigma still permits singular joint
states, including pure entangled states, through the proved regularization.
